Help me build this properly

Does this actually solve your problem, or not?

I built this to answer one question: what percentage do I type into my slicer. But I don't know if that is where your workflow actually breaks. Tell me what is broken, missing, or just plain useless here. Honest answers, especially negative ones, are worth more to me than anything else you could do on this page.

Get in touch

Questions about 3D printed miniature scale conversion? Found a wrong percentage, want a new gaming scale added, or have an idea for a new tool? Drop me a message below — I read every submission and reply when I can, usually within a couple of days.

Send me a message

The button takes you off-site to my Google Form. It asks for your name and email so I can reply — I keep your message only until the matter is resolved, then delete it. Privacy details

Response time

Usually a couple of days

Scale corrections get priority. I print a test piece on my A1 Mini to check before updating the site. Feature requests take longer because I need to think them through.
